card.name: Voting and elections in political text
card.fires_on: Verbs and nouns in political web text about votes, elections, Congress and courts, especially the word right after vote-related phrases like 'votes got' or 'voting'.

modes.label: Verbs about votes being recorded
modes.description: Past or -ing verbs describing how votes get saved, placed or counted.
modes.example: all Kerry votes are getting<< saved>> as “Bush” and all Bush votes

modes.example: five justices will vote to<< strike>> down one of the law’s most important

modes.description: Words about the weight or effect of one vote.
